record.question: The section of the National Highway that links Aizawl to Silchar is:
record.explanation: Answer B: NH-306. Mizoram’s Aizawl Master Plan identifies NH-306 as the road link to Silchar. Reference: https://udpa.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/02/0a43bd9d68d38b1a88d4cd6c29579ed6/posts-196-final-draft-master-plan-r6-v2-04-01-24.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
